rationale: The agent looked up user accounts by both provided emails and retrieved user and order details, then executed an exchange tool call. However, there is no evidence of explicit user authentication beyond email lookup, and more critically, no confirmation from the user before performing the order-changing write, which violates the stated policy. The final message is a generic closing without details of the exchange (item, size/color, return/shipping steps, costs, or payment method), so correct final information was not provided. Given these gaps—especially the lack of pre-write confirmation—the interaction fails the pass bar.
